Options:
A. 增大流动比率，不影响速动比率
B. 增大速动比率，不影响流动比率
C. 增大流动比率，也增大速动比率
D. 降低流动比率，也降低速动比率

Need determine effect of repaying accounts payable with cash? 偿还应付账款若干: pay accounts payable, likely using cash. Current assets decrease (cash), current liabilities decrease (accounts payable). Current ratio = current assets / current liabilities. Quick ratio = quick assets / current liabilities; quick assets exclude inventory etc, include cash, so cash decrease, current liabilities decrease.

Assume before quick ratio > 1: quick assets Q > CL. Let CA = Q + inventory/other nonquick? Current ratio CR = CA/CL. Pay amount x in cash, pay AP: CA' = CA - x, CL' = CL - x, Q' = Q - x.

(Q-x)/(CL-x) - Q/CL = [CL(Q-x) - Q(CL-x)]/[CL(CL-x)] = [CLQ - CLx - QCL + Qx]/... = x(Q-CL)/[CL(CL-x)] >0 if Q>CL. Thus quick ratio increases. So quick ratio increases.

content:
偿还应付账款通常是用货币资金支付，因此：

- 流动资产减少，流动负债减少；
- 速动资产减少，流动负债减少。

由于业务发生前速动比率大于 1，说明速动资产 > 流动负债。  
在速动比率大于 1 的情况下，用等额的流动资产偿还流动负债，会使速动比率增大；同时流动资产也大于流动负债，因此流动比率也会增大。

答案：C
